_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); athletic footwear and apparel signals

pit_profile.why: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2012 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2012 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 25.26x; +66% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.34; conservative 2yr -15%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.5%/yr (Q3 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.7%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NKE (retrospective, 2013-03-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 25.26x (42.4% downside to Bear $34 / +1.7% upside to Bull $60) | Adj composite 2.41 vs market 3.75: gap -1.34 [OVERVALUED] | +66% above the EPP floor $35 (15x FY13E $2.37) | Conservative 2-yr case: -15.4% total (-7.7%/yr) | At 25.0x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $78 sits above the BULL case; futures orders +6.0% in Q3 FY13, forward revenues +10% (Q3 FY13 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
